summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a proposed private offering of senior notes by its subsidiary, ICON Investments Six DAC, to refinance existing debt, including repaying bridge and term loans and redeeming its 5.809% Senior Secured Notes due 2027. No specific terms (size, price, premium) were disclosed in the excerpt. The offering is unregistered, under Rule 144A and Regulation S. This is a routine debt-refinancing event, not a special-situation category.
